variants.title: Amateur
variants.summary: For amateur radio. Leaves out business features.

off.name: DMR_PRIVACY
off.why: Encryption that hides the meaning of a message isn't allowed on the amateur bands in most countries

off.name: DMR_TMS
off.why: Motorola text message format: business radio fleets and dispatch software

off.name: DMR_ARS
off.why: Registration with a presence server: dispatch systems

off.name: DMR_LRRP
off.why: Location request and response for dispatch software (APRS covers positions on the amateur bands)

off.name: DMR_CONTROL_STATION
off.why: Control station mode for PC dispatch software

off.name: SNMP
off.why: Network management for fleets of radios

variants.title: Commercial
variants.summary: For business and public service radios. Leaves out amateur-only features.

off.name: HOTSPOT
off.why: The MMDVM hotspot links the radio to amateur networks (BrandMeister, TGIF) through a PC; split duplex goes with it

off.name: APRS
off.why: APRS is an amateur radio service; KISS over TCP and the APRS-IS client go with it
